s: God chose us in Christ before the foundation of the world. Paul prays that they may know the hope of his calling.
By grace you are saved through faith. Christ has broken down the wall dividing Jew and Gentile.
The mystery of Christ revealed to Paul. Paul prays that they may know the love of Christ.
One Lord, one faith, one baptism. Grow up into Christ. Put off the old self.
Walk in love as children of light. Husbands and wives in Christ, a great mystery.
Children and parents, servants and masters. Put on the armour of God.

2: Here: citizenship, the community one belongs to.
4: In older English “conversation” meant way of life and conduct, not talk.
